365:t_1:86.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It'll be fun to see how long you can keep saying that.」

365:t_1:87.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Yeah. Apparently it's something you're born with.」

365:t_1:88.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「In $$クロウ$$'s case, he's also born to rack up debts.」

365:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're... as hard on me as ever...」

365:t_1:90.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「...May I get back to the briefing now?」

365:t_1:92.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「We'll use the maneuverable $$オーガス$$ for the infiltration. $$桂$$, who shares his traits, will lead the search for our rescue target, $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$.」

365:t_1:93.en:
$$桂$$
「Once we get close, we can use the $$特異点$$ sensor Dr. $$トライア$$ prepared. It'll pinpoint $$オルソン$$'s location.」

365:t_1:94.en:
$$桂$$
(Since she prepared this, maybe the Doctor was thinking we'd have to rescue $$オルソン$$ someday, too...)

365:t_1:95.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$スザク$$, $$アレルヤ$$, and $$クロウ$$ will escort $$桂$$...」

365:t_1:97.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$竜馬$$, $$刹那$$, $$タケル$$, $$万丈$$, and $$シモン$$ will create diversions nearby.」

365:t_1:99.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「The sniper team, the $$プリベンター$$s, the $$エレメント$$s, $$キリコ$$, and $$エコーズ$$ will keep the enemy occupied outside the facility.」

365:t_1:101.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$l and Miss $$スズネ$$ will also act as special disruption personnel. $$ＳＲＴ$$ will escort them.」

365:t_1:102.en:
$n
「Understood. I'll decide when to summon $$ジェニオン$$ once we're on site.」

365:t_1:103.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will move in three hours. While it creates a diversion, the $$クォーター$$ will enter the atmosphere.」

365:t_1:104.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「This mission is the first step in our counteroffensive against $$サイデリアル$$... $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$.」

365:t_1:105.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$エクリプス$$... That means a solar eclipse.」

365:t_1:106.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ means a fixed star... But we can't let them claim the sun.」

365:t_1:107.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「We will make this mission succeed.」

365:t_1:110.en:
$$マオ$$
「Are you all right, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

365:t_1:111.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Should we ask $$ラルク$$ to take over the disruption role?」

365:t_1:112.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No... I'll do it. $n is going, too.」

365:t_1:113.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...There's still time before the operation begins. Calm yourself down before then.」

365:t_1:115.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$n... you're her partner, so I'm counting on you to look after Miss $$スズネ$$.」

365:t_1:116.en:
$$マオ$$
「See you, Miss $$スズネ$$. Let's make this a success and enjoy a good beer afterward.」

365:t_1:118.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... are you feeling anxious again...?」

365:t_1:119.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Right now, what worries me is that I don't feel anxious...」

365:t_1:121.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Ever since we broke the $$時の牢獄$$, the anxiety inside me kept growing.」

365:t_1:122.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And as though in response, the world fell deeper into crisis...」

365:t_1:124.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I wasn't afraid... Because you felt the same anxiety, $n, and you were fighting alongside me.」

365:t_1:125.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...And yet, now I don't feel anxious...」

365:t_1:126.en:
$n
「That's... because you've grown stronger inside, Miss $$スズネ$$...」

365:t_1:127.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I thought so at first, too... No, I tried to make myself think so...」

365:t_1:128.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But that's not it... I'm... afraid of who I am now...」

365:t_1:129.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I feel like I'm ceasing to be myself...」

365:t_1:131.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. I shouldn't be talking about this before the mission...」

365:t_1:132.en:
$n
「...Um... I can't put it very well... but I think you're still you, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

365:t_1:133.en:
$n
「Even when you're down, or you get hysterical sometimes, or turn devious, you're still Miss $$スズネ$$.」

365:t_1:135.en:
$n
「Ah, damn it... I wish I could put it better...」

365:t_1:136.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's enough. I understand how you feel.」

365:t_1:137.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, I'm all right now... Talking about what's been on my mind has cleared my head.」

365:t_1:139.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I am. There's no point lying to you, $n.」

365:t_1:140.en:
$n
「...Then that's fine. Let's do our best.」

365:t_1:142.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I don't know how long this feeling will last...)

365:t_1:143.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Someday... I'm sure I won't be able to fight alongside $n anymore... I have that feeling...)

365:t_1:144.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But I'm sure... $n can... even without me...)

365:t_2:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Are you going to be all right, $$セツコ$$?」

365:t_2:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I've had basic infantry training, too. I don't intend to hold anyone back.」

365:t_2:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's not what I mean. I'm talking about $$バルビエル$$.」

365:t_2:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$クロウ$$ told me he's got his sights set on you.」

365:t_2:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm starting to understand a little about him and me.」

365:t_2:9.en:
$n
「Is that why you volunteered for the infiltration team at the last minute, $$セツコ$$?」

365:t_2:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think $$バルビエル$$ and I have the same kind of relationship as $$ストラウス$$ and $$ランド$$.」

365:t_2:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So I think $$バルビエル$$ is trying to make me do whatever he wants...」

365:t_2:14.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Did you volunteer so you could defeat him yourself?」

365:t_2:16.en:
$n
(...$$セツコ$$ is lying... I sense something else in her...)

365:t_2:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「$n! Take $$セツコ$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ and move on ahead!」

365:t_2:20.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$桂木$$, $$流$$, and the others will probably be discovered before long, too!」

365:t_2:21.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「When the commotion reaches its peak, summon $$ジェニオン$$ and disrupt the enemy!」
